items.stem:
Vihaan recorded the scores of two players over five matches.
Player A: 20, 8, 4, 20, 13
Player B: 10, 18, 9, 21, 7
(i) Find the mean score of each player. (1)
(ii) Find the range of each player's scores. (1)

items.answer: (i) A: 65 / 5 = 13; B: 65 / 5 = 13 (ii) A: 20 − 4 = 16; B: 21 − 7 = 14 (iii) σA = √(204 / 5) ≈ 6.39; σB = √(150 / 5) ≈ 5.48; player B is more consistent (smaller standard deviation).

Aarav recorded the scores of two players over five matches.
Player A: 17, 18, 14, 3, 8
Player B: 15, 14, 4, 16, 11

(ii) Find the range of each player's scores. (1)
(iii) Find the standard deviation of each player's scores (divide by n) and state which player is more consistent. (2)
items.answer: (i) A: 60 / 5 = 12; B: 60 / 5 = 12 (ii) A: 18 − 3 = 15; B: 16 − 4 = 12 (iii) σA = √(162 / 5) ≈ 5.69; σB = √(94 / 5) ≈ 4.34; player B is more consistent (smaller standard deviation).
items.markingKey: 1 + 1 + 2 marks: (i) A: 60 / 5 = 12; B: 60 / 5 = 12 (ii) A: 18 − 3 = 15; B: 16 − 4 = 12 (iii) σA = √(162 / 5) ≈ 5.69; σB = √(94 / 5) ≈ 4.34; player B is more consistent (smaller standard deviation).
